publish-a11y-disclosure.title: 无障碍 Play 审核 disclosure 强化（onboarding copy + strings.xml）
publish-a11y-disclosure.description:
现状：onboarding 已有 WizardStep.Accessibility 这一步（OnboardingSteps.kt 中 permissionStepCopy），用户主动点 "Open Accessibility Settings" 跳转系统设置启用——这就是 affirmative consent 流程。但当前 copy 对 Play 审核而言不够，缺三件 Play 政策必查的内容：(a) 屏幕内容会发给 LLM 提供商；(b) 隐私政策链接；(c) 不在后台运行的明确说明。strings.xml 里 accessibility_service_description 也太简单（这是 Android 系统 Settings 里看服务时展开的描述，Play 审核也看）。

要做的事（窄）：
1. 重写 OnboardingSteps.kt 中 WizardStep.Accessibility 的 description（保留同样视觉布局，只扩 copy），加入 LLM 数据流向 / 隐私政策链接 / not-in-background 保证。

不做：不新增独立 consent dialog，不动 onboarding 结构。Affirmative consent 由用户主动点 Open Accessibility Settings 提供，符合 Play 政策（Voice Access 同模式）。

详见 projects/active/1_publish/3_privacy_claude.md, projects/active/1_publish/5_play_store_claude.md。

uam-qa.description: End-to-end QA of unified agent mode. Run on a real device or emulator. Verify: (1) settings page no longer shows mode dropdown and renders without crash; (2) main agent runs a simple task end-to-end with full UI tools; (3) delegate_task works from main agent and the subagent's actions appear streaming in chat history during delegation (Design C); (4) reload of a completed delegation session preserves subagent action cards in the chat row; (5) ask_user from a subagent displays the same overlay/capsule UI as ask_user from the main agent; (6) checkpoint reload after task completion (IDLE_READY state) restores parent history correctly; (7) full test + lint suite passes. Issues discovered during QA are fixed in-place as part of this task — do not gate progression on human approval. Output: projects/active/unified_agent_mode/qa_report_codex.md with Result, Flows Verified, Commands Run, and Notes.
acceptCriteria: projects/active/unified_agent_mode/qa_report_codex.md exists
QA report Result is PASS
./gradlew clean assembleDebug lint test passes (output captured in report)
Manual flows (delegation streaming visibility, subagent ask_user, reload) verified on device with evidence in report
Any QA failures filed as follow-up tasks before report is finalized

fix-active-turn-survives-rotation.title: Active agent turn survives MainActivity rotation/relaunch
fix-active-turn-survives-rotation.description: During post-rebase QA, the first delegation run was interrupted by a device orientation change. MainActivity relaunched while OpenAI streaming was in flight; the stream was closed, a returned delegate_task tool call was followed by JobCancellationException, and no ToolCallReceived/delegate_task execution occurred. Investigate session/lifecycle ownership so active agent turns are not canceled by Activity configuration changes or foreground relaunches, or explicitly handle the cancellation as a recoverable session error.
acceptCriteria: A debug-run remains active and either completes or emits a clear recoverable error if MainActivity rotates/relaunches during an LLM streaming call
Regression coverage or a documented manual repro exists for rotation/relaunch during an active turn
./gradlew --no-configuration-cache assembleDebug test passes
